column1: # Dragon Warrior Legacy - monster base stats
# Source: Dragon Warrior Legacy.dmb, class-table entry field +28 (per-type var init list).
# Regenerable cache. See notes/type-table-and-monsters.md for derivation and confidence.
# Column names are INFERRED - the var-name table has not been found, so these are read off
#   element          certain   - the stored values are literally element names
#   maxhp maxmp      high      - Metal Slime = 6 hp; maxmp present only on casters
#   level            high      - monotonic 1..40 across the roster
#   str agi vit int spr  high  - 5 consecutive var ids onto 5 consecutive stat strings
#   delay            high      - inversely monotonic with agi (4->24.8 .. 8->1.0 mean agi)
#   exp gold         medium    - equal on nearly every monster; ordered by Metal Slime only
#   flee             medium    - metal monsters highest, 0 on every boss; name is a guess
# 'delay' is lower = faster. Blank maxmp means the monster has no MP var at all.
